headword: {交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}

definitions.gloss: means of transportation; way of getting there
definitions.explanation: A way of traveling from place to place, such as train, bus, car, or bicycle.

examples.japanese: {交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: There's no way to get there.

examples.japanese: ⟦{主|おも}な→主な：21018_omona⟧{交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧だ。
examples.english: My main means of transportation is the train.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{公共|こうきょう}→公共：11652_koukyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{交通手段|こうつうしゅだん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: In rural areas public transportation is scarce, so a car is indispensable.
